description: v6.1 W1, the AutoMode arm again on the fixed code. The first W1 run (v6-w1-mixed) finished plain Opus and plain Sonnet high, 20/20 each, then found mid-way through AutoMode that the plugin store was full: no resumed session could restore its state, so AutoMode routed every step blind to the cache. Its 7 AutoMode steps stay in v6-w1-mixed.jsonl as the record of that bug. Same sessions, questions and tasks; compare with the Opus and Sonnet high rows of v6-w1-mixed.
